shortDescription: Indonesia's President Prabowo Subianto has asked a number of senior officials to attend a swearing in ceremony to fill top jobs, Praktino, the minister of human development, said on Monday.He did not provide details on the ceremony, which typically marks a cabinet reshuffle.
